integrity: All enumerated universes have explicitly proved exhaustive reductions; a separate agreement-pair algorithm and full-team enumeration check the difference-mask census, including the size-six extremal cases. No independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to nonempty finite Boolean teams on four named predicates, equivalent to singleton-domain modal supervenience profiles. Arbitrary domains and larger arity are not classified. The exact finite census depends on exhaustive, independently implemented computation, not on an asymptotic proof. Historical priority beyond inspected literature is not independently established.
title: Complete binary four-predicate supervenience spectrum and the sharp six-world boundary
